elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Client receives only a licence to results and work product; ownership is not granted.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no assignment by TrueLink to Client.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly retains all ownership and licence rights in the Interface, and no other TrueLink IP is assigned.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence covers all results and work product, including IP embodied in them, and is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results and work product is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to all results and work product is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Although the Credit Data licence is nonexclusive and limited, the clause does not state that Client owns or retains all rights in Credit Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink may use, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause creates only licences and preserves TrueLink's sole ownership of the Interface; it creates no joint ownership.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: No ownership is assigned away from TrueLink, and TrueLink expressly retains its ownership rights in the Interface, leaving its generic tools and know-how with TrueLink.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client's licence to all Support Services results and other work product is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Client's licence to all Support Services results and other work product is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Client's licence to all Support Services results and other work product is expressly worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client's licence to all Support Services results and other work product is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client may use and modify all results and work product for Client's business purposes.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client may sublicense all results and work product for Client's business purposes.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink's permitted Credit Data activities are limited solely to providing the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client.
